spoken_summary: Lara Trump and an unnamed RNC Chairman speak from the RNC headquarters on the day of the State of the Union address. The chairman praises Lara Trump, saying people want her back for the energy she brings. He also praises the current president, claiming he has "accomplished so much in this first year, more than most presidents do in eight years." He confidently predicts a win in the midterms and directs viewers to gop.com. Lara Trump adds a plug for a show on Fox News.
